mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling molten droplets into chondrules was most worthwhile: their textures preserve evidence of the heating and cooling process.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early hot-disk combinations were somewhat repetitive, and their exact partners were not obvious from the board.

surprise.text: Inherited grains can evaporate and recondense in the inner disk, while some inherited ice survives in the cold outer disk.

arbitrary.text: Using rock-forming dust rather than metal grains directly with the refractory grains was not obvious, although the resulting mixed aggregate had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the contrasting rocky and icy materials become larger bodies, because the chapter connected the combinations to physical processes.
